title: Warm British Pecan Nuts Scotch Egg
description: A British-inspired twist on the classic scotch egg, featuring roasted pecan nuts and a silky egg yolk. Serve warm for a satisfying snack or light meal.
instructions: Combine the pork sausage meat, eggs, flour, cheddar cheese, pecans, milk, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Mix the ingredients together until just combined.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts.
Shape each part into a ball and then flatten slightly into an egg shape.
Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the egg shapes to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the eggs from the skillet and place on a plate.
Dip each egg into the beaten egg for the egg wash, then roll in additional flour to coat.
Fry the eggs in the same skillet over medium heat for an additional 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve the warm scotch eggs immediately.
Warm the scotch eggs in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 5-7 minutes before serving, if desired.
